what: The blind second labeling of EV-1s (OQ-47 (d'')): an independent labeler, given eval/synthetic/LABELING.md and the 120 emails without their labels or hard-case tags, labeled each one. Company and role compared after TRK-1 normalization.

disagreements.why: the new message named no company; only the sender's domain and the quoted thread did

resolution: both rewritten so the new message names the company; a fresh blind labeler then agreed on every field of both
blind_labels: eval/synthetic/blind_labels.jsonl (the final blind labels, the two relabeled ones included)

added_after_freeze.why: four more invites inside a rejection, two per language, written after the freeze so the prompt can be tuned on dev for that case; both such emails in the frozen set fell in the test split
